# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

She is described by Nell as having the most exquisite hair, captivating eyes, and gorgeous attire with puffier sleeves than anyone else in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an engaging, innovative, and considerate educator who inspires affection and deep emotion in her students. She incorporates creative activities like fortnightly recitations, forest field days, and daily physical culture into her curriculum. She shows thoughtful care for her students' well-being, advising them to rest, walk, and refrain from cramming before entrance examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_

## History

Miss Thorne served as a female educator at Brierley School. During her tenure, she conducted bi-weekly recitations, led field trips to the forest to observe nature, and ran daily physical culture routines, though her methods drew criticism from Mrs. Sowerby. At the end of June, her reign as teacher in Brierley came to an end. Her moving departure speech left students like Nell and Isolde tearful and solemn. Prior to the Academy entrance exams, she extracted a promise from her students to refrain from cramming and focus on resting and walking instead. On the morning of the exams, she picked up Nell and drove her to the Academy, stopping along the way to collect pupils Odette, Opal, and Flossie.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
